title: Add Framework Command History Panel
description: Every app must show an append-only history of all commands in the UI (tree items with clickable actions incl. a backwards/revert action), plus a tri-state filter (include/exclude/exclusively operations). Commands are session-only; operations shown must match exactly what VCS tracks. Built framework-side once so both the React and native wgpu renderers get it for every app. MCP ticket tools unavailable (server not connected); managing ticket on disk, following the precedent of the 26/07/30 aggregator ticket.
summary: Implemented a framework-owned, append-only command-history panel auto-injected into every app's panel_tabs (framework.panel.history), shared verbatim by both renderers via a reserved body key intercepted in VcsDocumentApp::render. Session command log (CommandLogEntry/CommandView/HistoryCommandFilter/HistoryView.commands) lives in VcsDocumentApp, never persisted; op-text is derived live from envelope.vcs.edits so it always matches VCS exactly. Undo/redo/revertToCommand append entries, never remove any. New injected actions revertToCommand (History-kind) and setHistoryCommandFilter (View-kind) in framework core. ui_history_panel builder (plugin crate) renders header buttons + tri-state filter Select + newest-first Tree with per-row 'Backwards' action gated on revertible entries. React shell cut over its old six-button History tab to the injected panel tab; native wgpu gained an icon arm. Files: 🧰framework/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/📦lib.rs, 🧰framework/⚡️implementation/🟦typescript/📦index.ts, 🧰framework/🔨module/🖱️ui/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/🧊wgpu/📦lib.rs, 🧰framework/🛍️product/💻os/🔨module/🔌plugin/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/📦lib.rs, 🧰framework/🛍️product/💻os/🔨module/🏪store/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/📦lib.rs, 🧰framework/🛍️product/💻os/🔨module/📺renderer/⚡️implementation/🟦typescript/🧑‍🎨engine/⚛️react/📦index.tsx (+🧪index.test.ts), 🧰framework/🛍️product/💻os/🔨module/📺renderer/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/🧑‍🎨engine/🧊wgpu/📦lib.rs, and HistoryView::empty() fixture swaps in 9 app crates (space/home, space/space, layout, cad, remodel, architect manifest, fem 2d/3d, mathematical). Verified: semio-framework-plugin compiles clean and all 118 unit tests pass (7 new tests covering append-only invariants, coalesced-gesture single-entry, revert math, ingest backfill, filter interception, panel filter/gating); semio-framework-core, ui_wgpu, semio-framework-os-kernel-store also compile clean. Along the way, fixed ~50 pre-existing broken file references left by the concurrent EMOJI-PREFIX-ALL-RENAMABLE-FILENAMES rename (double-emoji-prefixed include_str!/import/package.json-export paths in icon_name.rs, several build.rs files, TS import graph, and a broken 🔣playgrounds.json path that was silently misrouting `bun ./script.ts dev vcs` to the compose-desktop Electron app) — these were blocking verification, are unrelated to this ticket, and are called out as pre-existing. Could NOT get an end-to-end browser run: `bun ./script.ts dev vcs` now correctly resolves the vcs playground but fails with 'Cannot find module @semio-tech/framework-os-core', which reproduces identically for untouched sibling packages (@semio-tech/framework-core, @semio-tech/ui-styling) — a pre-existing bun workspace module-resolution issue unrelated to these changes. React vitest suite also needs pre-built WASM `pkg/` artifacts not present in this environment. Follow-up recommended for: the bun workspace resolution gap, the math-graph-manifest registry codegen gap (needs `bun nx run @semio-tech/plugin-registry:generate`), and a full WASM build pass.
